Home / Our process
HOW IT WORKS

A clear journey from sample to understanding.

A focused examination connects the specimen, the purpose and the expected output from the very beginning.

A CONSIDERED JOURNEY

Seven steps. One clear purpose.

The practical technical steps differ by material and the requested scope. Good preparation makes each stage more focused.

01

Enquire

Describe your material and what you need to know.

02

Prepare

Gather specimen details, relevant documents and questions.

03

Submit

Arrange reception and an identifiable sample record.

04

Examine

Select an assessment suitable for the question.

05

Review

Relate observations and measurements to the specimen.

06

Report

Communicate findings in a useful and traceable format.

07

Complete

Address follow-up questions and agreed sample release.

BEFORE SUBMISSION

Prepare the context as well as the sample.

Start by recording the material type, count or approximate weight, available background documents and the decision the result should help support.

Agree on a receiving method before dispatching any valuable, hazardous, fragile or restricted material. Keep each specimen separately identified and protected.
